@idl.struct.description: Decorator for defining DDS data types as Python classes. This is the REQUIRED decorator for DDS type definitions in the modern Python API.
important_notes: Use native Python types (str, int, float, bool) for fields, NOT idl.int32 or idl.StringType
All fields MUST have default values
String fields that need bounded length use member_annotations with idl.bound(N)
Do NOT use @idl.dataclass - it does not exist in this API
common_mistakes: Using idl.int32 instead of native int
Using idl.StringType(64) instead of member_annotations with idl.bound(64)
Using idl.bounded_str[64] instead of member_annotations with idl.bound(64)
Putting bound() on non-string fields (only strings need bounds)

idl.bound.description: Specifies the maximum length for a bounded string field. Used inside member_annotations.
idl.bound.note: Only needed for string fields. Integer, float, and bool fields do not need bounds.
